reads.sell: A bright, juicy Beaujolais of red cherry, raspberry and violets, with the playful banana lift of whole bunch fermentation and almost no tannin. Serve it lightly chilled with charcuterie, roast chicken or a bistro lunch.

why.grape: Candied red cherry with the banana and bubblegum of carbonic maceration, high acidity and barely any tannin is Gamay.
why.climate: Tart to ripe red fruit, high acidity and modest alcohol on a light frame say a cool climate.
